subject: Mathematics
summary: Cordova Core Chapter 7 covering degrees of algebraic expressions, monomials, binomials, trinomials, polynomials, factor trees, column addition, and subtraction laws.

theory_summary.content:
- Monomial: 1 term ($7x^2$).
- Binomial: 2 terms ($2x + 3y$).
- Trinomial: 3 terms ($x^2 - 4x + 7$).
Highest power of variable in one variable ($5x^3 - 4x^2 + 7$ has degree 3). Highest sum of exponents in multivariable term ($3x^2y^3$ has degree 5).
Change the sign of every term in the subtrahend and add to the minuend: $-(a - b) = -a + b$.

questions.question: What is the numerical coefficient of the term $-7x^2y$?
questions.explanation: The numerical factor multiplying the variables is $-7$.

questions.question: What is the degree of the polynomial $5x^3y^2 - 3x^2y^4 + 7xy$?
questions.explanation: Degree is the highest sum of exponents in a single term. For $-3x^2y^4$, sum of powers $= 2 + 4 = 6$.

questions.question: If $x = 2$ and $y = -1$, find the value of $3x^2 - 2xy + y^2$.
An algebraic expression containing exactly three unlike terms is called a _______.
questions.explanation: Expressions with 1 term = monomial, 2 terms = binomial, 3 terms = trinomial.

questions.question: A term in an algebraic expression containing no variables is known as a _______ term.
questions.explanation: A constant term has a fixed numerical value independent of variable substitutions.

questions.question: $4xy^2$ and $-5x^2y$ are like terms. (True/False)
questions.explanation: Like terms must have identical variables with identical powers. In $4xy^2$ the power of $y$ is 2, whereas in $-5x^2y$ the power of $x$ is 2.

questions.question: Subtract $4a - 7ab + 3b + 12$ from $12a - 9ab + 5b - 3$.
questions.answer:
Arrange in column format and change the signs of the subtrahend:
$$\begin{array}{r@{\quad}l}
  12a - 9ab + 5b - 3 & \\
- (4a - 7ab + 3b + 12) & \\
\hline
  (12 - 4)a + (-9 + 7)ab + (5 - 3)b + (-3 - 12) & = \mathbf{8a - 2ab + 2b - 15}
\end{array}$$
questions.explanation: Standard column subtraction with sign reversal.

questions.question:
The three sides of a triangle are represented by $(3x^2 - 4x + 5)$, $(2x^2 + 7x - 2)$, and $(4x^2 - 5x + 1)$.
(a) Find a simplified expression for the perimeter of the triangle.
(b) If $x = 3\text{ cm}$, calculate the numerical perimeter.
questions.answer:
• **(a) Perimeter Expression**:
  $$\text{Perimeter} = (3x^2 - 4x + 5) + (2x^2 + 7x - 2) + (4x^2 - 5x + 1)$$
  Group like terms:
  $$= (3 + 2 + 4)x^2 + (-4 + 7 - 5)x + (5 - 2 + 1)$$
  $$= \mathbf{9x^2 - 2x + 4}$$
• **(b) Evaluation at $x = 3\text{ cm}$**:
  $$\text{Perimeter} = 9(3)^2 - 2(3) + 4 = 9(9) - 6 + 4 = 81 - 6 + 4 = \mathbf{79\text{ cm}}$$
questions.explanation: Geometric application of polynomial addition and numerical substitution.
